verdict.rationale: Salv is an AML and compliance SaaS that ships AI features such as AI-Powered Insights, so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack never mentions MCP client support or any way to connect external tool servers. Its REST API, webhooks and Slack status updates are separate capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
